description: This file defines a tracing utility for Kubernetes, including Trace and traceStep classes, with methods for creating, nesting, logging, and threshold-based reporting of trace steps.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: A key-value pair providing additional details about a trace.

classes.name: traceItem
classes.description: Interface for trace items that can be locked, unlocked, and written to a buffer.

classes.name: traceStep
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a step in a trace with timestamp, message, and fields.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Main class for managing a set of trace steps, nesting, and logging with threshold-based filtering.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Field as 'Key:Value'.

methods.name: writeFields
methods.description: Writes a list of Fields to a buffer, separated by commas.

methods.name: writeTraceItemSummary
methods.description: Writes a summary of a trace item including message, duration, and start time.

methods.name: durationToMilliseconds
methods.description: Converts a time.Duration to milliseconds.

methods.name: rLock
methods.description: Locks the traceItem for reading.

methods.name: rUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks the traceItem after reading.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the traceStep.

methods.name: writeItem
methods.description: Writes a traceItem to a buffer, respecting stepThreshold and verbosity.

methods.name: rLock
methods.description: Locks the Trace for reading.

methods.name: rUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks the Trace after reading.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns the end time or start time if incomplete.

methods.name: writeItem
methods.description: Writes the Trace details and nested steps to a buffer.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Trace with a name and optional fields.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Adds a new step to the Trace with a message and optional fields.

methods.name: Nest
methods.description: Creates and nests a new Trace within the current one.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs all steps of the Trace, including nested traces.

methods.name: LogIfLong
methods.description: Logs the Trace only if it exceeds a specified duration threshold.

methods.name: logTrace
methods.description: Logs the Trace if it exceeds the threshold, including nested traces.

methods.name: writeTraceSteps
methods.description: Writes all trace steps and nested traces to a buffer.

methods.name: durationIsWithinThreshold
methods.description: Checks if the Trace duration is within the threshold.

methods.name: TotalTime
methods.description: Returns the total duration since the Trace was created.

methods.name: calculateStepThreshold
methods.description: Calculates the threshold for individual trace steps based on total threshold.

methods.name: FromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a Trace from a context.Context.

methods.name: ContextWithTrace
methods.description: Returns a new context with the given Trace included.
